summary: Added real Angular Material, dialog, keyboard/focus, theme-storage and open-dialog accessibility coverage; made browser-only theme persistence resilient to unavailable storage.

resolutions.resolution: TestBed/CDK harness now selects a real mat-select option; the pilot test opens and closes MatDialog, verifies restoreFocus and runs axe-core while the dialog is open; the switch is driven by Space and Enter with focus and disabled-state assertions.

Theme preference is restored and saved through document.defaultView localStorage only on browser platforms, guarded for missing/throwing storage; tests provide browser storage and verify persistence across a recreated component.
axe-core exposed an unnamed Material dialog; the dialog now receives an explicit Portuguese ariaLabel and the open-dialog scan passes with no serious or critical violations.

validation.details: 8 Angular Vitest/TestBed tests passed, including MatSelectHarness, MatDialog open/close/focus restoration, Space/Enter switch interaction, persisted theme and axe-core for form and open dialog. Standalone production build and full workspace verification passed; GOMAXPROCS=1 avoids a transient esbuild deadlock observed when Angular runs after Next.js under host Node 26.
